A1.justification: Both 34-page PDFs describe the same StreetUnveiler study and contain readable text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–G. Full-document text and rendering comparisons support reliable assessment.

before.justification: v3 reports original Waymo and Pandaset experiments and ablations in Section 6, plus timing, geometry, and qualitative results in the appendices.

after.justification: v4 retains the original experimental results in Tables 1–7 and the main-text and appendix qualitative evaluations.

M1.justification: Sections 4–5 and Appendix A retain the same hard-label semantic 2DGS, losses, alpha-map masking, time-reversal inpainting, and re-optimization procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same Waymo and Pandaset coverage, including street reconstruction, object removal, geometry evaluation, novel-view examples, and appendix pedestrian and simple dynamic-object cases.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains LaMa, SDXL, ProPainter, SPIn-NeRF implemented in 2DGS, and Infusion. The appendix comparisons retain LeftRefill in Table 4 and StreetSurf in Table 7, with unchanged comparator membership.

E3.justification: Section 6 retains the scene counts, front-camera selection, image resolutions, and LPIPS/FID evaluation procedures. Appendix timing and geometry protocols, including sampling, mesh cropping, and evaluation thresholds, are also unchanged.

E4.justification: The inpainting-supervision, representation, temporal-order, and semantic-label ablations are unchanged. Geometry comparisons, computational analysis, segmentation failure examples, and supplementary case studies are also retained.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical. Tables 5–6 retain timing averages over eight scenes per dataset; neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All entries in Tables 1–7 and qualitative result images are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains the proposed method's LPIPS/FID values of 0.216/127.581 on Waymo and 0.261/155.527 on Pandaset.

T1.justification: Mathematical definitions and Equations 1–11, including Gaussian rendering, optimization losses, and environment-map blending, are unchanged. No assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introductory contribution bullets, and conclusion retain the same claims concerning semantic 2DGS, alpha-map masking, time-reversal inpainting, empty-street reconstruction, and free-viewpoint rendering.

C2.justification: Interpretations of temporal consistency, geometry quality, and computational cost remain unchanged. Appendices D–F retain the same qualifications concerning segmentation errors, challenging dynamic objects, and side or rear cameras.

D1.justification: Hardware, hyperparameters, initialization, training stages, keyframe processing, and local re-optimization details are identical. Project-page and supplementary-viewer access information also remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2 and the reference list retain the same cited works and research positioning. A related-work sentence crosses a different page boundary without any wording change.

P1.justification: Page 1 adds Yanwei Fu's affiliation with the Fudan ISTBI–ZJNU Algorithm Centre for Brain-inspired Intelligence, Zhejiang Normal University. Author footnote markers and the arXiv version/date stamp change; scientific prose and section order remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The additional footnote causes limited reflow on pages 1–4, including a vertical shift of Figure 2 and text moving across page boundaries. Figure and table content and captions are unchanged; pages 5–34 render identically.

improvement.justification: The added affiliation makes author information more complete, but the accompanying layout shifts have no substantial effect on readability. Methods, evidence, interpretations, limitations, and reproducibility information, including all appendices, remain unchanged, yielding no meaningful overall quality difference.
